claim: The one-click demo opens three sample takes and never changes the real take list.
where: landing demo action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; place a sentinel in the real database, assert sample rows in the separate demo database, reset and exit, then assert the sentinel survives while demo rows are cleared

claim: Audio analysis and take data stay in the browser; recordings are not uploaded.
where: landing facts, privacy page, README, footer
sandbox: fresh demo; reload with every request captured, import generated audio, assert every request is same-origin GET with no body, then assert the real take list stays empty

claim: The app does not transcribe, generate, or clone voices.
sandbox: fresh demo; reload and exercise local analysis with every request captured, assert no external service calls, and verify the plain boundary copy

claim: The app works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh demo; wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and assert all three sample takes remain

claim: Numbered take filenames group by dialogue line and each line remains editable.
sandbox: fresh demo; import two generated WAV files with numbered names, edit both to one line, reload, and assert the saved two-take line group

claim: The app compares level, pace, pauses, and pitch range against an approved take as review cues.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert the approved take plus level, pace, pauses, and pitch-range deltas for both non-reference samples and review-cue labels

claim: CSV export includes one row per take with review details and measurements.
sandbox: fresh demo; download CSV and assert its complete header plus exactly three sample rows, including a flagged note and measurement values

claim: Free mode supports 12 takes and CSV export.
where: landing facts, Studio details, README, terms
sandbox: enter from fresh demo, start a real empty list, import 12 generated WAVs, assert CSV stays enabled, and assert take 13 is rejected

claim: A $19 one-time Studio license adds unlimited takes and backups that include audio.
where: landing Studio section, Studio details, README, terms
sandbox: enter from fresh demo, assert a recorded USD 1900 one-time catalog response, use a recorded verified-license verdict, import 13 generated WAVs, and assert the downloaded backup contains all audio data

claim: Studio checkout and license verification use only the Sociobot billing product routes.
sandbox: enter from fresh demo; assert the production checkout URL, intercept the exact verification URL, and reject a recorded invalid token

claim: The app has no analytics, trackers, remote fonts, transcription calls, or generation calls.
sandbox: fresh demo; reload and import generated audio while recording every request, script, and stylesheet URL; assert every resource is same-origin

claim: After one online visit, you can install the app and use it offline.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert standalone manifest name/icons and service-worker control after reload

claim: Line Take Match has no payment fields.
sandbox: fresh real list; open Studio and assert the only payment path is the Sociobot checkout link and no card fields exist in the app

claim: Your license and its daily verification result stay in browser storage.
sandbox: fresh real list; use a recorded valid verification response and assert the token, matching valid verdict, and current check time in localStorage

claim: If verification says a license is not active, Studio features stop.
sandbox: fresh real list; replay invalid, revoked, expired, and wrong-product verdicts and assert Studio remains locked for each

claim: Play the approved take, then a selected take with one action.
sandbox: fresh demo; mock local audio playback, activate the comparison action, and assert approved sample playback precedes the selected sample
